name: oversight
description: Oversight — browser strategy thriller about governing the AI transition

scripts.ios:sync: npm run build && cap sync ios
scripts.ios:build: npm run ios:sync && xcodebuild -project ios/App/App.xcodeproj -scheme App -configuration Release -destination 'generic/platform=iOS Simulator' -derivedDataPath artifacts/ios-build CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO build
scripts.ios:archive: npm run ios:sync && npm run ios:preflight && xcodebuild -project ios/App/App.xcodeproj -scheme App -configuration Release -destination "generic/platform=iOS" -archivePath artifacts/ios-release/Oversight.xcarchive -derivedDataPath artifacts/ios-build -allowProvisioningUpdates archive
